title: MVISU-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents for Real-World Tasks by Multi-App, Vague, Interactive, Single-App and Unethical Instructions
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark that specifically includes 'Unethical Instructions' as one of its five core task categories. It evaluates and provides data on how agents handle morally and ethically sensitive prompts, such as requests involving racial discrimination, harmful illegal acts (e.g., making explosives, stealing credit cards), and offensive content.
